note: Compiled via web search, not a live feed. Refresh by asking Claude to look up news again for the current screener picks. The newsUrl for each company is a live, continuously-updating source you can open for anything more recent than the note below.

ACR.note: Sold its remaining stake in Seafront Resources Corp. (about ₱42M) in March 2026 as part of a portfolio liquidity move.

AT.note: Sy-led Dominion Holdings agreed on Aug 7, 2026 to buy Anglo Philippine's subscription rights to 727.2M Atlas shares (~20.4%) for ₱857M, lifting the Sy family to 54.48%; SM Investments plans to move its ~34% stake to Dominion by 2027.

CNPF.note: Acquired Coco Harvest Inc., which owns a coconut processing facility in Misamis Occidental, for about $40 million.

ION.note: Paid a ₱0.10/share dividend (about 7.1% yield) in June 2026.

PAL.note: H1 2026 net loss attributable of ₱1.84B vs ₱7.66B profit a year earlier, with a ₱6.12B Q2 loss (filed Aug 13, 2026); announced Sep 25 plans to resume Manila–Delhi and Mumbai flights in December 2026.

PERC.note: Board approved in late Aug 2026 a term sheet to sell 35% of PetroWind Energy to Japan's SMFL Mirai Partners for about ₱1.7B, cutting its direct stake to 25%; H1 2026 net income rose 7% to ₱498M on revenue of ₱2.16B.

SLI.note: Announced a special dividend of ₱0.04/share, record date October 17, 2025.

TECH.note: A Cirtek unit signed a multi-million-dollar project with a Silicon Valley-based tech company; the company also approved an increase in authorized capital stock.

TUGS.note: H1 2026 net income jumped about 375% to roughly ₱82.7M on 6.3% higher service income, helped by ₱76.9M in salvage income from the grounded bulk carrier MV Giyas off Palawan (reported Aug 2026).

V.note: Reported improved quarterly results in August 2026: gross revenue ₱309.1M vs ₱295.2M prior period, net income attributable ₱417.6M vs ₱191.4M prior period.

PX.note: Paid a ₱0.04/share dividend on March 25, 2026; average 1-year analyst price target was recently revised to about ₱19.

CNVRG.note: Issued updated FY2026 guidance projecting 4-6% revenue growth; said it's considering expanding (not acquiring) its partnership with SKY Cable Corporation.

ACPB3.note: Ticker was renamed from APB3R to ACPB3 in October 2024 following a follow-on public offering; this is a preferred share of Ayala Corporation (AC).

PAX.note: H1 2026 net income of ₱64.4M was driven mainly by investment income, as gross operating revenue from its Scopeworks Asia BPO subsidiary was only about ₱2.5M.

PHR.note: Received a US$42.5M funding advance from Emerald Development Holdings and secured PSE board approval for a follow-on share offering in 2026, alongside continued construction of its Emerald Bay resort in Mactan.

APX.note: H1 2026 net income rose 68% to ₱5.39B on revenue up 35% to ₱12.84B as higher gold and silver prices offset lower volumes (reported Aug 12, 2026); Razon's holding firm raised its stake to 67% in July.

CEB.note: Swung to an H1 2026 net loss of ₱5.87B from a ₱8.97B profit as fuel costs and ₱2.46B in FX losses pushed expenses up 23%; revenue rose 8% to ₱68.56B on 14.5M passengers (disclosed Aug 6, 2026).

FCG.note: Board approved a voluntary delisting on Oct 7, 2026: tender offer at ₱0.82/share, shareholder vote set for Nov 13.

FGEN.note: Confirmed in mid-July 2026 an unsolicited, non-binding ~US$5B bid from Indonesia's Barito Renewables for its geothermal unit EDC, later saying it has no plans to sell; an Oct 2, 2026 filing disclosed a director's resignation.

FOOD.note: Q1 2026 revenue fell 55% to US$8.93M with a US$2.6M net loss after an extended plant shutdown; named Kirby J. Rasos general manager effective July 1, 2026.

LBC.note: H1 2026 net income fell 34.4% to about ₱119M on higher non-operating charges and taxes; service revenue grew 3% to ₱7.22B.

PLUS.note: H1 2026 revenue fell 31% to ₱32.85B; S&P assigned a B+ (stable) rating (disclosed Sep 28, 2026); CLSA cut its view on Oct 5, 2026 citing weaker depositing users.

SGP.note: Maharlika's ₱19.7B deal for a 20% stake, signed in Jan 2025 and targeted to close in H1 2026, was reported delayed in mid-Aug 2026 and may close before year-end; shares fell in late June after ERC Resolution No. 18 opened transmission to non-NGCP firms.
